title: Security & Privacy: General
description: Stops users changing the password and controls the lock message.

dontAllowFireWallUI.title: Dont allow fire wall UI
dontAllowFireWallUI.description: If true, disables user changes to the firewall settings.

dontAllowLockMessageUI.title: Dont allow lock message UI
dontAllowLockMessageUI.description: If true, disables user changes to the lock message.

dontAllowPasswordResetUI.title: Dont allow password reset UI
dontAllowPasswordResetUI.description: If true, disables user changes to the password.
